detect_high_cardinality_features: detect high cardinality categorical columns in a pandas DataFrame using a configurable uniqueness threshold
compute_cardinality_metrics: compute unique value count, unique ratio, and missing value presence for a pandas Series
make_df_column_names_unique: make duplicate DataFrame column names unique by appending numeric suffixes to duplicates
pd_convert_all_types: convert all columns of a specified input dtype to a target output dtype in a DataFrame
are_dtypes_equal: compare two DataFrame dtype Series and return whether shared columns have matching dtypes
